limitations: Research port uses bounded 16-token context and up to 4 generated tokens per EVM call.

modelManifest.storage_format: 8 biased weights in radix-2**32 lanes per 256-bit word; signed int256 row sum after each row; raw int16 embeddings and norm vectors
modelManifest.packed_duplicate_storage_parameters: Storage duplication only; every numerical tensor is unchanged

packing_checks.includes: padded lengths, signed extremes, random full-range inputs, actual EVM 256-bit multiplication truncation

limitations: All measurements are on an isolated local chain, never mainnet.
Weights are injected as verified runtime data shards; their deployment costs are not measured.
All weights, transformer layers, and full output vocabulary are evaluated; no row proxy or distilled replacement is used.
INT16 fixed-point arithmetic approximates the original FP32 checkpoint. Exact agreement here is with the independent integer reference.
A token-limited continuation is not described as a complete answer. EOS and actual generated token count are reported separately.
Elevated local gas controls do not demonstrate usability under the normal 32M ceiling.

streamingDesign.promptPrefill: One input token per swap; N tokens require N swaps before the first completion.
streamingDesign.cacheScope: Model namespace bound to hook address and pool id
streamingDesign.resetPolicy: Restart fixed configured prompt after EOS, context16, or configured output cap
streamingDesign.fullHiddenInEvents: Included for validation and in measured gas
